items.title: Hollander POTD Vernon Maxwell. Mad Max was Florida SG & 47th pick in 88 by SA. Tough defender & shot a lot of 3s. Sold to HOU in 90 & was starter for 5 yrs & a title. Let go in 95 after tiff w/Rudy T. Was a role player from 95-03 w/7 teams. A bit nutty but fun to watch.
